snippet.title: Cat Me If You Can - Trailer | GamingUp Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Can you find every cat hiding in plain sight?

Cat Me If You Can is a cozy hidden-cat adventure that takes the genre into fully explorable 3D worlds. Wander through handcrafted environments drawn entirely in a distinctive black-and-white comic style, search every corner and photograph the cats hiding throughout each scene.

Frame the perfect shot and watch every cat you photograph spring to life in full colour. Some are easy to spot, while others require you to solve riddles, unlock doors or figure out curious contraptions before they'll reveal themselves.

Explore locations ranging from the sun-soaked sands of Ancient Egypt and the streets of modern Japan to medieval castles — all at your own pace. No timers, no fail states and no enemies. Just explore, look closer and complete your collection.

Wishlist Cat Me If You Can now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3170490/Cat_Me_If_You_Can/

Launches on Steam September 8, 2026.

Coming to Nintendo Switch and Xbox Series in Q4 2026.
